 1               P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                THE PRESIDENT:   The Senate will 

 3   come to order.  

 4                I ask everyone present to rise and 

 5   repeat with me the Pledge of Allegiance.

 6                (Whereupon, the assemblage recited 

 7   the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

 8                THE PRESIDENT:   Today's invocation 

 9   will be given by the Reverend Peter Young, of 

10   Mother Teresa Church in Albany.

11                REVEREND YOUNG:   Let us pray.  

12                O God, we enjoy this great gift of 

13   good weather with its very bright sunshine, and 

14   we warmly welcome our Lieutenant Governor to the 

15   Senate hospitality and prayer.  

16                As budget preparations are 

17   prioritized, may God guide our legislation for 

18   our citizens of New York State and bless our 

19   members with these most difficult decisions.  

20                We pray that they have the wisdom 

21   needed to guide New York State to the proud 

22   leadership position of being in name and in 

23   position as the Empire State.  

24                We ask You this in Your name, now 

25   and forever.  Amen.

 1                THE PRESIDENT:   Thank you, 

 2   Reverend.

 3                The reading of the Journal.

 4   129, by Senator Martins, Senate Print 298, an act 

 5   to amend the General Municipal Law.

 6                THE PRESIDENT:   Senator Sanders.

 7                SENATOR SANDERS:   I just wanted 

 8   permission to explain my vote.

 9                THE PRESIDENT:   Read the last 

10   section.

11                THE SECRETARY:   Section 2.  This 

12   act shall take effect upon enactment.

13                THE PRESIDENT:   Call the roll.

14                (The Secretary called the roll.)

15                THE PRESIDENT:   Senator Sanders.

16                SENATOR SANDERS:   A pleasure.  

17                I just wanted to take a moment to 

18   welcome our Lieutenant Governor to the chamber 

19   for the first time.  We hope that your arm gets 

20   better also.

21                It's wonderful to have a woman 

22   presiding over this body, and it's good that 

23   you're here in Women's History Month.  The more 

24   women that we have in leadership, the better.  

25                As a matter of fact, we have a 


                                                                680

 1   leader that we believe should be in the 

 2   negotiations in speaking about everything.  And 

 3   I'm hoping that this democracy spreads and that 

 4   we all see the beauty, in Women's History Month, 

 5   of having women in places of leadership.

 6                I want to thank you for that.  And 

 7   on the bill, I think it's a good bill, and I'll 

 8   vote in its favor.

 9                (Laughter.)

10                THE PRESIDENT:   Announce the 

11   result.

12                THE SECRETARY:   Ayes, 60.
